strengths: Source digests and upstream locators are preserved in generated federation products.
Reference identity profiles are separated from evidence claims.
Unknown, absent, contested, uncoded and missing states are not silently collapsed in the v1 pattern engine.
Crosswalk-dependent feature pairs are removed from pattern testing.
Pulotu and DRH remain separate statistical cohorts.
Crosswalks include semantic-drift guards for curated DRH questions.
A versioned source-dependence primitive distinguishes same-work, derived, shared-dataset and shared-sample families without treating author overlap or citations as dependence.
PubMed/MEDLINE discovery is isolated as a candidate mechanism/context channel with anti-retrodiagnosis guardrails.
OpenAlex candidate metadata and Pleiades place linking have dedicated adapters with tests and non-evidentiary policies.
Public projections are generated deterministically and validated in CI.

blind_spots.finding: Pattern screening does not yet control for phylogeny, spatial autocorrelation, known contact, research intensity, or richer missing-data mechanisms. A source-dependence graph now exists, but current pattern candidates do not yet consume it.
blind_spots.next_gate: Make source-dependence groups an analysis input, then require phylogenetic/spatial/contact-aware models plus missing-data sensitivity before any relationship can be promoted beyond descriptive candidate status.

blind_spots.finding: The v1.8 source-dependence graph currently fingerprints 7 sources and encodes 1 blocking dependency edge. Absence of an edge is explicitly not proof of independence.
blind_spots.next_gate: Fingerprint every source entering promoted claims/tests with exact dataset snapshots, samples/cohorts and parent/derived relationships; link systematic reviews to included primary-study families.

blind_spots.finding: Only 39 of 4234 standardized DRH questions have curated NOEMA crosswalks (0.92%).
blind_spots.next_gate: Expand mappings in reviewed thematic batches with semantic-drift tests; never use keyword auto-mapping as evidence.

blind_spots.finding: 526 religion/ritual/divination-related D-PLACE variables are routed for review but are not accepted semantic assertions.
blind_spots.next_gate: Review and crosswalk high-value variables, preserving upstream variable IDs and licensing.

blind_spots.finding: The starter reference catalog still contains 8 pre-v1 dimension keys. These are discovery tags, not accepted comparative ontology.
blind_spots.next_gate: Publish a normalized reference projection that preserves legacy tags for search but exposes comparative dimensions only after explicit canonical crosswalk review.

blind_spots.finding: Repository migrations model datasets, feature assertions, analyses, relationship candidates, identity names/links and media review, but the deployed runtime database is not yet verified at this schema level.
blind_spots.next_gate: Apply and verify migrations 001-006 on the runtime database, then publish DB-backed projections through the read-only API.

blind_spots.finding: PubMed discovery is operational with 7 query families in the latest inspected run and 2 retained candidates after a strict title gate, but biomedical studies remain candidate mechanism/context sources and cannot be projected into historical populations.
blind_spots.next_gate: Review underlying papers, fingerprint samples/datasets, and require explicit phenomenology/cultural-role bridge evidence before cross-domain hypothesis testing.

blind_spots.finding: OpenAlex normalization and Pleiades linking are adapter-ready, while Seshat and ARIADNE remain next-stage integrations rather than live federation inputs.
blind_spots.next_gate: Add a versioned Seshat snapshot adapter and a provider-preserving ARIADNE discovery adapter before expanding claims of source coverage.

blind_spots.finding: Global search is ontology-expanded lexical retrieval, not a calibrated hybrid vector + metadata search.
blind_spots.next_gate: Publish versioned embeddings or a deterministic semantic index with model/version metadata and lexical fallback.

blind_spots.finding: The reference layer currently has 11 deity/spirit/agent cards and no verified authority-link coverage metric yet.
blind_spots.next_gate: Add authority IDs, multilingual names, historical variants, source-specific identities, and reviewed merge/split decisions through migration 006.

blind_spots.finding: 0 media assets currently pass an explicit rights-status gate in the starter reference catalog, although separate reviewed museum/Commons reference-media projections exist.
blind_spots.next_gate: Unify reviewed media identity/rights status into the entity-level provenance view without treating reference imagery as evidence.

policy: This health report is an engineering/research-readiness audit, not a scientific confidence score.
